speaker: Raj
text: Developed tools, we built a wall. We built the pyramids. Math, science, history, unraveling the mystery that all started with a big bang. It's true. I've seen him at the beach. He's like a human chicken wing.

speaker: Leonard
text: Oh, damn it. Can I have a napkin? You have a whole bunch of them.

speaker: Sheldon
text: I'm sorry, no. Yes, I've moved to a four napkin system. Lap, hands, face, and personal emergency. If you like, starting tomorrow, I'll add a guest napkin, but I'm afraid there's nothing I can do for you today.

speaker: Sheldon
text: Good luck. That's the face napkin.

speaker: Howard
text: So, have you talked to Penny yet? Why not?

speaker: Leonard
text: No, I haven't. Because I've been busy, because I haven't figured out a way to bring it up, and mostly, and I can't stress how key this is, because I don't want to.

speaker: Howard
text: Leonard, a pact is a pact. You have to get Penny to fix me up.

speaker: Leonard
text: It's not that simple. What am I supposed to say? Penny, do you have any friends you'd like to never hear from again?

speaker: Howard
text: Come on, I'm smart, I have a good job, and I have only 3% body fat.

speaker: Howard
text: Leonard, come on.

speaker: Leonard
text: Fine, I'll ask if she has a friend for you. Right.

speaker: Howard
text: A hot friend. And tall. I want our kids to be able to ride Space Mountain before they're 20.

speaker: Leonard
text: I'll see what I can do.

speaker: Raj
text: Hey, Sheldon, guess what I heard today?

speaker: Sheldon
text: I'd imagine you heard any number of things today. When you arrived at work, you undoubtedly heard, hello, Raj. How are you, Raj? And given that you're wearing a new sweater vest, you may have heard new sweater vest. And possibly the far less likely nice sweater vest.

speaker: Raj
text: Why don't I just tell you what I heard today?

speaker: Sheldon
text: That would probably save us some time.

speaker: Raj
text: Saturday night at the comic book store, they're having a Mystic Wallets of Kaha tournament. First prize is 500. If we team up, we'd be unstoppable.

speaker: Sheldon
text: I'm sorry, Raj, but I have no interest in playing a game in which I find no challenge. I have money.

speaker: Raj
text: What about the money? This is other money.

speaker: Sheldon
text: How does it differ from the money I have?

speaker: Raj
text: Half of it will be mine.

speaker: Sheldon
text: Do you need it to buy a less disturbing sweater?
